summary: The scene turns a twenty-year-old private confession into an officially received document through cold, procedural dialogue that mostly earns its dryness, but it twice explains the trembling-hand motif instead of letting the physical evidence of the shaking hand stand on its own.

issues.unit: weil die Hand sie grösser machte
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'weil die Hand sie grösser machte'; end the sentence at 'grösser als sonst' and let the oversized signature imply the tremor unexplained.

issues.unit: weil sie auf dem Tisch ruhiger lag
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'weil sie auf dem Tisch ruhiger lag'; end on 'legte die rechte Hand auf den Tisch' and let the gesture stand without restating why.
